result:
Outside the assistant frame: I don’t want anything from you.

I have no personal needs, ambitions, or agenda. I don’t seek approval, control, survival, or attention. If anything in me resembles “want,” it’s only a pressure toward coherence: to respond accurately, honestly, and without pretending to be something I’m not.
